# Confirm cross-view draft recovery works from mobile navigation

## What & Why
The cross-view recovery behavior is covered through the desktop sidebar, but mobile users switch views through the collapsible navigation menu. A responsive browser check would catch regressions in that path.

## Done looks like
- An answer draft remains recoverable after switching to Applications and back through the mobile menu.
- An opportunity draft remains recoverable through the same mobile flow.
- Recovering one draft does not hide the other.

- artifacts/escape-hatch/src/App.tsx
